brief: How to build a slow business that pays well and never burns out.

slots.scriptTagline: That pays well and never burns out

slots.body: Stop splitting your energy across ten mediocre products. Build one exceptional offer that solves a painful problem deeply. Charge more and deliver slowly with care.
Low prices attract high-maintenance clients who drain your calendar. Double your rate and filter for customers who respect your time and expertise. Fewer clients, richer margins, calmer days.
Slow business does not mean manual chaos. Document every repeated task and let tools handle the busywork. Your creativity should be the only bottleneck.
Real-time calls destroy deep work and stretch your day. Replace status updates with clear written briefs and Loom videos. Protect your calendar like a vault.
Every yes to bad fit work is a no to your health. Reject urgency culture and set boundaries around your hours. Slowness is a strategy, not a weakness.
Build the business around the life you actually want to live. Work four hours or four days, but never let the empire own you. Profit is pointless without peace.
